claims.text: The hotel opened on the Bund in 2009.

findings.quote: Opened on the historic Bund in 2009
findings.note: opening year and Bund location stated

claims.text: The hotel sits at the far end of the Bund, on the western bank of the Huangpu River.

findings.quote: The Pen occupies a prime spot at the far end of The Bund, a little curve, a mere eyelash of a street on the western bank of the Huangpu River
findings.note: far end of Bund, western bank of Huangpu

claims.text: The hotel pairs Art Deco-inspired interiors with contemporary comfort.

findings.quote: effortlessly harmonises exquisite Art Deco-inspired interiors with contemporary comfort

claims.text: Rooms look over the forecourt, the Bund or the Pudong skyline.

findings.quote: views overlooking the forecourt, the historic Bund or Pudong skyline

claims.text: Deluxe Garden Rooms look towards the historic Garden Bridge across Suzhou Creek.

findings.quote: Deluxe Garden Rooms offer a soothing green vista of trees, looking towards the historic Garden Bridge across Suzhou Creek

claims.text: The Astor Suite has a 115 sq m terrace with a private whirlpool tub and views over the Bund and the Huangpu River.

findings.quote: This suite also features a 115 sq m (1,238 sq ft) terrace with a private whirlpool tub and stunning views over the Bund and the Huangpu River.
findings.note: Astor Suite terrace size, tub and views

claims.text: Sir Elly's Restaurant serves Northern Italian cuisine high above the Bund, with views across the Bund.

findings.quote: Set high above the Bund, Sir Elly’s pairs a more contemporary expression of Northern Italian cuisine with expansive views across the Bund

claims.text: Sir Elly's wine list has over 400 labels.

findings.quote: Sir Elly’s wine list offers an impressive selection of over 400 labels

claims.text: Sir Elly's Terrace is a rooftop bar on the 14th floor.

findings.quote: Rooftop Bar and Terrace
Sir Elly’s Terrace, on the 14th floor, has some of the finest views of any rooftop bar in the city

claims.text: The indoor heated swimming pool has an Art Deco fireplace.

findings.quote: indoor heated swimming pool, complete with an Art Deco fireplace

claims.text: The Peninsula Spa holds a Five-Star rating from Forbes Travel Guide 2026.

findings.quote: The Peninsula Spa is awarded the prestigious Five-Star rating from the pioneering Forbes Travel Guide 2026

claims.text: Sir Michael Kadoorie, the hotel's owner, has forebears who came to Shanghai from Baghdad in the mid-19th century.

findings.quote: The hotel’s sentimental value to owner Sir Michael Kadoorie is immense. His forebears came to Shanghai from Baghdad in the mid-19th century.

claims.text: The Schindler Group produced a replica of a 1930s antique lift, originally housed in the Belgian Lift Museum in Brussels, for the hotel.

findings.quote: The Schindler Group specially produced this replica of an antique lift from the 1930s, originally housed in the Belgian Lift Museum in Brussels, for The Peninsula Shanghai.

claims.text: The hotel owns four Extended Wheelbase Rolls-Royce Phantoms, six BMW Peninsula Editions and a seven-seat Mercedes-Benz Sprinter, all finished in Peninsula Green.

findings.quote: owns four bespoke Extended Wheelbase Rolls-Royce Phantoms, six BMW Peninsula Editions, and a seven-seat Mercedes-Benz Sprinter, all finished in signature Peninsula Green

claims.text: The Rosamonde Aviation Lounge celebrates the history of aviation in China with a collection of antiques and memorabilia, including a life-size replica of the Leoning at its entrance.

findings.quote: The Rosamonde Aviation Lounge celebrates the fascinating history of aviation in China and, with its impressive collection of antiques and memorabilia, including a life-size replica of the Leoning at its entrance

claims.text: The Palace Suite has a 1,098 sq m terrace, which the hotel describes as the largest private terrace on the Bund.

findings.quote: Palace Suite - with a 1,098 sq m (12,000 sq ft) terrace, which is the largest private terrace on the Bund

claims.text: TAKIYA SHANGHAI is the first international outpost of TAKIYA, a Japanese tempura restaurant.

findings.quote: TAKIYA SHANGHAI is the first international outpost of Japan’s legendary tempura restaurant, TAKIYA.

claims.text: All indoor areas are non-smoking and the hotel no longer offers smoking guest rooms.

findings.quote: The Peninsula Shanghai is no longer able to offer smoking guest rooms, and all indoor areas including restaurants have been designated as non-smoking areas.

claims.text: Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult at the pool.

findings.quote: Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the historic Bund location can get heavy tourist crowds during peak seasons.
